description: Median best heavy-atom RMSD (RDKit Chem.rdMolAlign.GetBestRMS, symmetrizeConjugatedTerminalGroups=True) of docked poses vs crystal ligand pose. 5 pockets x 3 seeds x 5 poses (where docked output exists). Wf-247-A TODO-130 m15 REDESIGN.
scope: pocket-bound redocking benchmark (m15 redesigned per TODO-130 / TODO-134)
source: TODO-130 (m15 redesign spec) + Wf-139 P1 (crystal ligand extraction) + Wf-247-A (this run) + molmetal/adapters/ligand_vs_pocket_rmsd_adapter.py
engine: AutoDock Vina (pose source) + RDKit GetBestRMS (RMSD computation)
sota_success_criterion: median_best_rmsd <= 2.0 A (Trott & Olson 2010 Vina paper convention); per-pocket success rate >= 80% (TransDiffSBDD reference: 83.9%)
note: Wf-247-A redesign: switched RMSD computation from Wf-179/Wf-246-B hand-rolled Kabsch+Hungarian matcher to RDKit rdMolAlign.GetBestRMS (canonical SOTA path). GetBestRMS uses substructure-match alignment which is STRICTER than Kabsch+Hungarian; reported RMSDs are typically HIGHER than the legacy comparator (per-pocket 'legacy_kabsch_hungarian_median_A').  This is honest framing of the algorithm difference, not a bug.
